.. change::
    :tags: usecase, postgresql
    :tickets: 6511, 9693, 13447

    Added explicit schema-qualified collation support.  String types,
    :func:`_sql.collate`, and PostgreSQL :class:`_postgresql.DOMAIN` accept a
    separate ``collation_schema`` argument, and PostgreSQL reflection now
    preserves collation names and schemas independently for columns and
    domains while omitting inherited default collations.  Dotted collation
    names are never split.  Original pull requests courtesy Denis Laxalde.
